mapper.sql: select s.schedule_id, s.agent_id, s.shift_id, date_format(s.schedule_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as schedule_date, s.schedule_type, s.status, s.check_in_time, s.check_out_time, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark, a.agent_name, w.shift_name, date_format(w.start_time, '%H:%i') as start_time, date_format(w.end_time, '%H:%i') as end_time from ai_agent_schedule s left join ai_call_agent_status a on s.agent_id = a.agent_id left join ai_work_shift w on s.shift_id = w.shift_id
